description: Plan cache ops view: total size and plan count, single-use (ad-hoc pollution) ratio, per-database and object-type breakdown, fleet inventory, and alert-aligned pollution watch. Collector: mssql_plan_cache (120s). Per-db panels need enriched collector redeploy.

panels.description: Largest plan caches in the fleet - memory pressure and eviction risk.
panels.title: Top Servers by Cache Size

panels.description: Alert threshold 50% (SqlPlanCacheSingleUseRatioHigh). High values suggest ad-hoc query pollution.
panels.title: Top Servers by Single-Use %

panels.description: Breakdown by cacheobjtype (Adhoc, Prepared, Proc, View, ...).
panels.title: Size by Object Type

panels.description: Plans executed only once - prime candidates for forced parameterization or plan guides.
panels.title: Single-Use Plans by Type

panels.description: Overall plan cache footprint per server.
panels.title: Total Cache Size

panels.description: Fraction of cached plans with usecounts=1. Sustained rise often precedes CACHESTORE_SQLCP pressure.
panels.title: Single-Use Ratio

targets.expr: (mssql_plan_cache_single_use_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", objtype=~"${objtype:regex}"} / mssql_plan_cache_plan_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", objtype=~"${objtype:regex}"}) and (mssql_plan_cache_plan_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", objtype=~"${objtype:regex}"} > 0)

panels.description: Large average plan size per type can indicate bloated plans or missing parameterization.

targets.expr: (mssql_plan_cache_size_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", objtype=~"${objtype:regex}"} * 1024 / mssql_plan_cache_plan_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", objtype=~"${objtype:regex}"}) and (mssql_plan_cache_plan_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", objtype=~"${objtype:regex}"} > 0)

panels.title: Avg Plan Size by Type (KB)

panels.description: Database resolved from plan dbid attribute. Requires redeploy of enriched mssql_plan_cache collector.

targets.expr: max by (instance, db) ((mssql_plan_cache_db_size_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} * 1024 / mssql_plan_cache_db_plan_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"}) and (mssql_plan_cache_db_plan_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} > 0))

panels.title: Server + database rollup - size, pollution, ad-hoc pressure

targets.expr: max by (instance) ((mssql_plan_cache_single_use_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", objtype="Adhoc"} / mssql_plan_cache_plan_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", objtype="Adhoc"}) and (mssql_plan_cache_plan_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", objtype="Adhoc"} > 0))

panels.description: Largest plan-cache footprint per database context.
panels.title: Top Databases by Cache Size

panels.description: Adhoc + high single-use % usually means literal SQL without parameterization. Prepared/Proc should typically have lower single-use ratios.

targets.expr: max by (instance, objtype) ((mssql_plan_cache_single_use_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", objtype=~"${objtype:regex}"} / mssql_plan_cache_plan_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", objtype=~"${objtype:regex}"}) and (mssql_plan_cache_plan_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", objtype=~"${objtype:regex}"} > 0))

max by (instance, objtype) ((mssql_plan_cache_size_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", objtype=~"${objtype:regex}"} * 1024 / mssql_plan_cache_plan_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", objtype=~"${objtype:regex}"}) and (mssql_plan_cache_plan_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", objtype=~"${objtype:regex}"} > 0))

max by (instance, objtype) ((mssql_plan_cache_size_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", objtype=~"${objtype:regex}"} / mssql_plan_cache_total_size_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}) * 100)

panels.title: Per object type - size, count, reuse, share of cache

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (mssql_plan_cache_single_use_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}) and on(instance) (mssql_plan_cache_single_use_ratio{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} > 0.5)

panels.description: Focus remediation on forced parameterization, OPTIMIZE FOR AD HOC WORKLOADS, or application-side parameterized queries.

targets.expr: topk(25, (mssql_plan_cache_single_use_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", objtype="Adhoc"} / mssql_plan_cache_plan_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", objtype="Adhoc"}) and (mssql_plan_cache_plan_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", objtype="Adhoc"} > 0))

panels.title: Adhoc types with highest single-use ratio

panels.description: Database-level pollution hotspots after collector redeploy.

targets.expr: mssql_plan_cache_db_size_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} and on(instance, db) (mssql_plan_cache_db_single_use_ratio{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} > 0.5)

mssql_plan_cache_db_plan_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} and on(instance, db) (mssql_plan_cache_db_single_use_ratio{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} > 0.5)

mssql_plan_cache_db_adhoc_size_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} and on(instance, db) (mssql_plan_cache_db_single_use_ratio{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} > 0.5)
